refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to implement exponentiation on e

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoMathExp calculates the e to the power of argv[0].

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoMathExp returns a pointer to an object representing the result of the exponentiation function. If argc is not 1, the returned value will be an error value with value SilikoErrorFunctionArguments.

refsection.title: Conformance
refsection.para: The SilikoMathExp function conforms to Siliko Core’s interface for pure functions and can be installed into a SilikoEngine if wrapped with SilikoPureFunctionCreate.
